name: Image
description: Shows a picture: reads it through the preview bridge and draws it on a page of its own -- fit to the window or 100%, with the pixel size and the byte size in the header, and a checkerboard behind anything transparent. What is shown is decided by the file's own first bytes rather than by its name, so a text file renamed .png is refused with a sentence instead of drawn as a broken picture. Read-only: there is nothing here that writes.
